scenes.heading: Every US airport *stopped*
scenes.narration: On Friday, every airport in America stopped taking off. All at once. And the cause was one small box.
Planes already flying kept going. But for over four hours, nothing new took off.
Here's why. After takeoff, your plane is guided by one of twenty-two control centers you never see.
Controllers there keep planes apart by talking. To pilots, and to each other.

scenes.label: of 22 centers lost *their lines*
scenes.narration: That afternoon, seventeen of the twenty-two started losing those lines.
A controller who can't talk can't keep planes apart. So officials stopped every departure.
Was it a cyberattack? Officials say no.
At one remote site, contractor L three Harris was switching old copper lines to fiber. Routine work.
One router there began flooding the network. Over a thousand connection attempts, every five seconds.
Investigators still don't know if the router was faulty, or installed wrong.
One box. A whole country, grounded.
